skill_name: Find the facts that explain a certain phenomenon.
workflow: People find focusing on one task for a long time difficult because of several factors.  First, it is difficult to maintain focus over a long period of time without breaks or distractions. Second, multitasking can be much more efficient than focusing on one task for a long time, allowing people to accomplish more in less time.
